text: {"567":{"about":["rustc_ast"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_ast defines the compiler's internal unstable TokenStream type."},"568":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":["rustc_ast"],"why":"rustc_expand implements conversion between internal and stable procedural-macro token streams, while rustc_ast only defines the internal type."},"569":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":[],"why":"The procedural-macro token-stream conversion implemented by rustc_expand uses the C ABI."},"570":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_expand implements procedural macros, including custom derive macros."},"571":{"about":["rustc_expand"],"refers":[],"why":"rustc_expand's mbe machinery implements the declarative macro system being extended with hygiene and scoping features."}}
